$comment: The only hand-written part of the token catalog. One entry per token whose role the source comment cannot state on its own: either it has no comment, or the comment above it describes a neighbour. `purpose` is the role sentence shown in the catalog; `stability` is alpha unless a token has been deliberately settled.

--iui-components-general-background-defa.purpose: The page behind everything. Nothing is painted under it.

--iui-components-general-border-default.purpose: The line that separates one area from another: dividers, table rules, the edge of a panel. The edge that identifies a control is --iui-components-general-border-control.

--iui-components-general-foreground-defa.purpose: Ordinary reading text on background or surface.

--iui-components-general-foreground-seco.purpose: Text that supports the main text: hints, captions, units. Still has to reach 4.5:1.

--iui-components-general-background-disa.purpose: The fill of a control that cannot be used right now.

--iui-components-general-foreground-disa.purpose: The text of a control that cannot be used right now. It is exempt from the contrast minimum, so never carry meaning by this colour alone.

--iui-components-general-focus-ring-colo.purpose: The colour of the ring that shows where the keyboard is. It needs 3:1 against whatever it is drawn on.

--iui-components-general-background-hove.purpose: The translucent state layer laid over a control, action, option or row while the pointer is on it. It preserves the role of the fill underneath.

--iui-components-general-background-pres.purpose: The overlay laid over a control while it is being pressed.

--iui-components-general-action-primary-.purpose: The fill of the one action a screen is asking for: the primary button, and the selected state that follows from it.
The same fill while the pointer is on it or it is being pressed.
Text and icons drawn on the primary fill.

--iui-components-general-action-secondar.purpose: The fill of an action that is present but not the one being asked for. Same hue as the primary: secondary is a job, not a second colour.
The secondary fill while the pointer is on it or it is being pressed.
Text and icons drawn on the secondary fill.

--iui-components-general-feedback-info-s.purpose: The colour of a message that tells you something, without anything being wrong.

--iui-components-general-feedback-succes.purpose: The colour of a message that says something worked.

--iui-components-general-feedback-warnin.purpose: The colour of a message that says to be careful.

--iui-components-general-feedback-danger.purpose: The colour of a message that says something failed, and the fill of an action that destroys something.
The danger fill while the pointer is on it or it is being pressed.

--iui-components-general-feedback-solid-.purpose: Text and icons drawn on a solid status fill: information, success, danger.

--iui-components-general-feedback-warnin.purpose: Text drawn on the warning label fill (solid Tag, Count). It is dark, because the light warning colour cannot carry white text.

The fill behind a text label with the warning status: the solid Tag and the Count. The warning colour gives dark text 3.8:1 only; this fill gives it 4.5:1 or more. Glyphs, dots and meter fills keep the warning colour.

--iui-components-general-emphasis-backgr.purpose: An area that should stand out from the page around it, such as a tooltip or an inverted panel.

--iui-components-general-emphasis-foregr.purpose: Text and icons drawn on the emphasis area.

--iui-components-general-feedback-info-b.purpose: The edge of the tinted information surface.

--iui-components-general-feedback-succes.purpose: The edge of the tinted success surface.

--iui-components-general-feedback-warnin.purpose: The edge of the tinted warning surface.

--iui-components-general-feedback-danger.purpose: The edge of the tinted danger surface.

--iui-components-general-selection-foreg.purpose: Text and icons drawn on a selected item.

--iui-components-general-emphasis-border.purpose: The edge of the emphasis area.

--iui-components-general-feedback-neutra.purpose: The colour of a message that carries no status at all.
The quiet fill of a control or chip that carries no status: a plain tag, a default button.
The edge that goes with the quiet neutral fill.

--iui-components-page-background-default.purpose: The page behind everything, per theme (component.light.page-background and component.dark.page-background in the design source): the background role in the light theme, Black in the dark one. The application paints it; the components do not.

--iui-components-card-background-default.purpose: The background of a card, per theme: the background role in the light theme, Grey 950 in the dark one.

--iui-components-card-secondary-backgrou.purpose: The background of a card with the secondary surface, per theme: the neutral surface role in the light theme, Grey 900 in the dark one.

--iui-components-dialog-background-defau.purpose: The background of a dialog panel, per theme: dialog, sheet, alert, confirm, prompt and search dialogs. The background role in the light theme, Grey 950 in the dark one.

--iui-components-popover-background-defa.purpose: The background of a popover, per theme: popover, hover card, date picker popups and the navigation menu panel. The background role in the light theme, Grey 950 in the dark one.

--iui-components-menu-background-default.purpose: The background of a menu or a listbox, per theme: dropdown menu, context menu, menubar menus, combobox and multi-select listboxes. The background role in the light theme, Grey 950 in the dark one.

--iui-components-sidebar-background-defa.purpose: The background of a sidebar, per theme: the background role in the light theme, Black in the dark one.

--iui-components-code-block-background-d.purpose: The background of a code block, per theme: Grey 50 in the light theme, Grey 950 in the dark one. The text keeps 4.5:1 on it; the border draws its edge against the page.

--iui-components-dialog-overlay-default.purpose: The scrim behind a modal dialog, per theme (role.light.dialog-overlay and role.dark.dialog-overlay in the design source). How far it sets the dialog apart from the page is a theme choice, not an accessibility requirement.

--iui-metrics-density-touch-min-target-s.purpose: The side of the smallest square hit area a control keeps under a coarse pointer: 44 by 44 (density.touch.min-target-size). Visual density never reduces it.

--iui-elevation-overlay.purpose: The shadow under something floating over the page: a menu, a popover, a dialog. It changes between themes, because a shadow reads differently on a dark page.

--iui-components-general-border-control.purpose: The boundary that identifies an interactive control: fields, outlined buttons, check controls, the switch track. It reaches 3:1 on the page and on a surface; the generic border stays the quieter line between areas.

--iui-components-general-action-secondar.purpose: The secondary action's fill: the quiet tint the secondary button paints.
Text and icons drawn on the secondary action's fill.

--iui-components-general-action-danger-b.purpose: The destructive action's fill: the danger button. Distinct from the danger status tint, which sits under a message rather than an action.

--iui-components-general-action-danger-f.purpose: Text and icons drawn on the destructive action's fill.
